detail.longDescription: Until recently I didn't understand what cold email really was and I accepted its price as one of those "it is what it is" things. But exploring the topic, I realised that there is no reason someone should have to pay for cold email, so I built FlyHedwig. With FlyHedwig you can manage hundreds of email addresses, schedule sending times, import lists, get stats... all the good stuff. Ah, and it's got some cool AI-classification and draft built in. If you work with cold email, I'd love to hear your thoughts! And if you like the project, as it's OSS, starring it would help it reach more people and encourage me to continue to improve it!
